Seam-Finder Thrust.name: Seam-Finder Thrust
Seam-Finder Thrust.description: The user reads the joints of an armored or hardened opponent and drives the weapon's point into a gap: elbow, armpit, knee or hip. The thrust ignores armor, shields and hardened skin, deals piercing damage with a blade or bludgeoning damage with a blunt weapon, and the struck arm or leg cannot grip or bear weight until the end of the target's next turn. Stamina: demanding.
